{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for the treatment arm
treatment_df = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
num_treatment = len(treatment_df)

# Check how many responded in the treatment arm
num_responded = treatment_df['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = num_responded / num_treatment

# Print results
treatment_df.head(), num_treatment, num_responded, fraction_responded"}
